content.comment_body: Is it possible to change how quickly messages move across the Message Text box? I checked both the forum and manual but didn't find anything on this. I don't expect the feature, but if it exists I wouldn't want to overlook it.

You can adjust this in File > Message Text Settings. Look for the 'Ticker Timer Setting' option. You’re only able to set the speed for 'Character by character'; the 'Line by line' option is automatically assigned and is always ten times your chosen value for 'Character by character'.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to change the message scroll speed in a Message Text box, but finds that only the character-by-character speed can be set. The line-by-line timing is fixed and not adjustable, limiting control over the feature.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for adjustable settings that allow control over both character-by-character and line-by-line message scroll speed.
